name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.machine.view.TransferActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this form to transfer selected machines to a chosen team member. The user chooses a machine type and recipient, reviews cashback details, and submits the transfer.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents machine transfers to team members.
